package.name: hrpsys_ros_bridge
package.description: Stopgap ROS 2 port of the ContactState messages from hrpsys_ros_bridge used by the jsk_rviz_plugins contact_state_marker sample. Definitions match the ROS 1 package (https://github.com/start-jsk/rtmros_common). Only the message subset used here is provided; remove this package once an official ROS 2 release of hrpsys_ros_bridge exists.
